title: Create Unexplored
description: A fresh take on the cool mod Create!
body:
## Create Unexplored – A World of Discovery and Creativity

**Welcome to Create Unexplored, a modpack designed to elevate the possibilities in Create to a new level.** This modpack combines an impressive selection of mods focused on creative building, exploration, and crafting a truly unique 
world. With a strong emphasis on the Create mods, Create Unexplored offers limitless opportunities for building complex machines, futuristic structures, and fantastical creations.

### Key Features:

*   **Create Dominance:** At the heart of the modpack is the Create series, with all its expansions including Structures, Trimmed, Steam ‘n’ Rails, Brass Tools, Goggle Placement, and more. You’ll discover endless possibilities for building 
intricate machines, futuristic buildings, and fantastic structures.
*   **Exploration and Adventure:** “Create Unexplored” encourages exploration with mods like Explorify, YUNG’s Bridges, Tectonic, Dungeons and Taverns, YUNG’s Better Dungeons, and YUNG’s Better Mineshafts. Discover new biomes, dungeons, and 
underground structures.
*   **Customization and Improvement:** Enhance your gameplay with mods like Transmog (for unlimited item transformations), ModernFix, Essential Mod, YUNG’s Better Ocean Monuments, and more. Upgrade your tools, storage, and overall gameplay.
*   **OptiFine Integration:** Improve the visual experience with Iris Shaders and Full Brightness Toggle for a breathtaking visual experience.
*   **Community Focus:** This modpack was designed with the community in mind, offering many useful tools and expansions.

### Additional Highlights:

*   **Performance:** With mods like Sodium, Entity Culling, and FerriteCore, the game will run smoother and more reactively.
*   **Customization:** Use mods like Tom’s Simple Storage Mod, YACL, and U Team Core to customize the game to your liking.
*   **Communication:** Utilize Simple Voice Chat for communication with your friends.
